description: This file contains Alembic database migration scripts for schema changes related to the 'datasources' table and associated foreign key relationships in the Superset project. It includes upgrade and downgrade functions to modify constraints and columns for migration purposes.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema upgrades: adds columns, constraints, and migrates data for 'datasources', 'columns', and 'metrics' tables.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts schema changes made in upgrade: restores previous constraints and columns.
